metadata.description: The full 199-case matrix uses dtype-specific candidate-sized batches targeting at least 1 ms. Equivalent NHWC, NCHW and NCHW_FAKE workloads share batch sizes. Calibration measurements are not reference-SKU baselines.

workload_calibration.method: Initial integer batch estimates from the fastest qualified A100/H100 CUDA 12/13 mean and the latest local A100X candidate measurements; layouts and overlapping basic/advanced variants remain paired. New-size execution validation pending.
